defs.def: not having, experiencing or showing sth 没有；缺乏

ex.s: I still made it through the next three years of college, even without the book.
ex.t: 即使没有那本书，我也顺利读完了大学剩下的三年。

ex.s: Beauty group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 美感组中没有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Control group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 对照组中没有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Don’t leave the harbor without a traditional Cornish pie.
ex.t: 离开港口前，别忘了尝一个传统的康沃尔馅饼。

ex.s: “Students who are around plants perform better academically than students who are in a classroom without plants,” says Knuth.
ex.t: “身边有植物的学生，学业表现优于在没有植物的教室里的学生，”Knuth说。

ex.s: Without the education I was throwing away, I’d turn to theft and go to prison.
ex.t: 没有我正在抛弃的教育，我会走上偷窃的道路，然后进监狱。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: The house seemed quiet as a tomb without the boy living there.
ex.t: 没有男孩住在那里，房子安静得像座坟墓。

ex.s: “Without anybody left in the house but us, this place could use a bit of fun.
ex.t: 屋里除了我们没有别人留下，这地方倒是可以找点乐子。

ex.s: Money offered without conditions.
ex.t: 没有任何条件提供的钱。

ex.s: After sharing the story online， I heard from someone，who（7）     the lady as Erin Smith． Without（8）     ，I called to thank her． She said she （9）     my wallet on a bus seat． She （10）     that going to a stranger's house was a（11）      move， but she decided to take the chance． "If I were in that（12）     ． I would want someone to try to find me，"she said．
ex.t: 在网上分享这个故事后，有人联系我，他（7）_____那位女士是艾琳·史密斯。我（8）_____地打电话感谢她。她说她（9）_____我的钱包在公交车座位上。她（10）_____去陌生人家里是个（11）_____的举动，但她决定抓住机会。“如果我处在那种（12）_____。我会希望有人试着找到我，”她说。

ex.s: The path to Dawson was covered with thirty feet of wet snow that could fall without warming.
ex.t: 通往道森的道路覆盖着三十英尺厚的湿雪，可能毫无预兆地滑落。

ex.s: He said without the job, he would   49   have too much time and would just do what I did back in  50  .He said that if he   51   the job, he would lose his   52  to work and succeed.
ex.t: 他说如果没有这份工作，他____49____会有太多时间，只会像我当年在____50____时那样做事。他说如果他____51____失去这份工作，他就会失去工作和成功的____52____。

ex.s: While regularly eating out seems to   61  (become) common for many young people in recent years, it’s not without a cost.
ex.t: 尽管近年来经常在外就餐对许多年轻人似乎___61___（become）平常，但这并非没有代价。

ex.s: Few want to live without search engines or a quick delivery.
ex.t: 很少有人愿意生活在没有搜索引擎或快捷快递的世界里。

ex.s: Without the glaciers, water will arrive in the rivers at times when it can damage crops.
ex.t: 如果没有冰川，水会在破坏农作物的时期流入河流。

ex.s: Without immediate medical care, Paris would die.
ex.t: 如果没有及时的医疗救治，Paris 会死。

ex.s: Without oxygen the brain is damaging quickly.
ex.t: 没有氧气，大脑会迅速受损。

ex.s: As Aristotle said, no one would choose to live without friends, even if he had all other goods.
ex.t: 正如亚里士多德所说，没有人会选择没有朋友的生活，即使他拥有所有其他商品。

ex.s: As Aristotle said, no one would choose to live without friends, even if he had all other things.
ex.t: 正如亚里士多德所说，没有人会愿意没有朋友地生活，即使他拥有所有其他东西。

ex.s: Those without outside space can rent small pieces of land on which to grow things.
ex.t: 那些没有户外空间的人可以租用小块土地来种植东西。

ex.s: “That’s so sad,” he said, “but you still know all those words, even without the book.” I realized that this was true.
ex.t: “那太遗憾了，”他说，“不过即使没有那本书，你依然认识那些词。”我意识到这话确实没错。

ex.s: And you’ll never be without something to read.
ex.t: 而且你再也不会没有东西可读。

ex.s: Finally, I conducted an elegant experiment that would not have been possible without the help of the members in the lab.
ex.t: 最终，我进行了一项精巧的实验，若没有实验室成员们的帮助，这项实验是不可能完成的。

ex.s: Without my beloved beaches and endless blue—sky days, I felt at a loss and out of place.
ex.t: 没有我心爱的海滩和无尽的蓝天日子，我感到迷茫和不自在。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: The second drawer began to fill and as it did I wondered whether there were bigger discoveries out there, not just species, but life that depends on things thought to be useless, life even without DNA.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉开始装满，就在它装满时我想知道外面是否还有更大的发现，不只是物种，还有依赖被认为无用的东西生存的生命，甚至没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: You cannot overcome them without ample motivation.
ex.t: 没有充足的动力你无法克服它们。

ex.s: Without motivation you can neither set a goal nor reach it
ex.t: 没有动力，你既无法设定目标，也无法达成目标

ex.s: Many works of fiction appeared without the names of the authors, often with something like “By a lady.”Novels, for the most part, were looked upon as silly, immoral, or just plain bad.
ex.t: 许多小说作品出版时没有作者名字，往往只署类似“一位女士著”。小说在很大程度上被看作愚蠢、不道德，或者干脆就是烂。

ex.s: （2）Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain？ Give two reasons．（no more than 15 words）
ex.t: （2）作者为什么没有到达山顶就匆忙回家？给出两个原因。（不超过15个词）

ex.s: It’s an amazing accomplishment and one we connot achive without generous support from individuals, corporations, and other social organizations.
ex.t: 这是一项了不起的成就，如果没有个人、企业和其他社会组织的慷慨支持，我们不可能取得这样的成就。

ex.s: ● If your news station or school requires interviewees to sign release forms to appear on the air, don’t leave work without them.
ex.t: ● 如果你的新闻台或学校要求受访者在出镜前签署免责声明表格，没有完成这项工作就不要离开。

ex.s: She couldn’t understand why some people had to live their lives without shelter or enough food.
ex.t: 她无法理解为什么有些人不得不过着没有住所、没有足够食物的生活。

ex.s: I guess I’ve always been a big meat eater and in this house, no family meal is complete without some form of meat.
ex.t: 我想我一直是一个大型肉食者，在这所房子里，没有某种形式的肉类，任何家庭用餐都是不完整的。

defs.def: not in the company of sb 不和 … 在一起；无 … 相伴

ex.s: The budget line is an elementary concept that most consumers understand intuitively without a need for graphs and equations — it's the household budget, for example.
ex.t: 预算线是一个基本概念，多数消费者凭直觉就能理解，无需图表和方程——比如家庭预算。

ex.s: Using them without a trainer present is forbidden．
ex.t: D．无训练员在场时使用是被禁止的。

defs.def: not using or taking sth 不用；不拿；不带

ex.s: A wise man can live without self﹣pity．
ex.t: B．智者能不带自怜地生活。

ex.s: Both the hand movements and the very   48    of communicating without speaking   49  me.
ex.t: 手部动作以及不用说话就能交流的这种非常____的方式都____了我。

defs.def: not doing the action mentioned 不（做某事）；无；没

ex.s: The idea of sea level as a reference point for elevations has by now been around for so long as to go essentially unnoticed-we mention it without even considering what it means.
ex.t: 以海平面作为海拔参照点的想法如今已存在如此之久，以至于几乎被人忽视——我们提到它时甚至不去思考它的含义。

ex.s: If you think you can do without the fence because you’ve never seen a fox, consider if the existence of the fence is precisely why you’ve never seen one.
ex.t: 如果你认为自己不需要围栏，因为你从没见过狐狸，那不妨想想：也许正是因为有了围栏，你才从没见过狐狸。

ex.s: In my defence, I did what we’ve all done before, which is to repeat received wisdom without exploring the nuances.
ex.t: 为我自己辩护一下，我做了我们所有人都做过的事，那就是在不探究细节的情况下重复人云亦云的观点。

ex.s: The moment I got off the plane, I ran like crazy through the airport building and jumped into the first taxi on the rank without a second thought.
ex.t: 我一下飞机，就发疯似的跑过航站楼，想都没想就跳上了排队的第一辆出租车。

ex.s: The moment I got off the plane, I ran like crazy through the airport building and jumped into the first taxi on the rank without a second thought.
ex.t: 我一下飞机，就发疯似的跑过航站楼，想都没想就跳上了排队的第一辆出租车。

ex.s: Without batting an eye he would   48   a translated Emerson passage before asking about the literary influence of American   49   as a whole.
ex.t: 他连眼都不眨一下，就会先___48___一段爱默生译作，然后才问及美国___49___整体的文学影响。

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: If people remove food and attractants from their yards and campsites, grizzlies will typically pass by without trouble.
ex.t: 如果人们把食物和引诱物从自家院子和营地清除，灰熊通常会顺利通过而不惹麻烦。

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: If you enjoy cooking, for example, you may faithfully follow a recipe without questioning the instructions.
ex.t: 例如，如果你喜欢烹饪，你可能会忠实地遵循食谱，而不质疑其中的说明。

ex.s: 36   When you are first trying to think of ideas for an essay, put your pen to your paper and write nonstop for ten or fifteen minutes without letting your pen leave the paper.
ex.t: 36 当你最初试图为论文想点子时，把笔放在纸上，连续写十到十五分钟，不让笔离开纸。

ex.s: The next technique is to write your draft rapidly without worrying about being perfect.
ex.t: 下一个技巧是快速写草稿，不必担心完美。

ex.s: Without a word, I rushed him to the hospital.
ex.t: 我二话不说，把他急忙送进医院。

ex.s: We talked endlessly through the curtain to pass the time, without seeing each other.
ex.t: 我们隔着帘子不停地聊天来消磨时间，彼此看不见对方。

ex.s: It’s affordable, and it’s got a fun atmosphere without being too noisy.
ex.t: 它价格实惠，氛围有趣又不太吵。

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 恰到好处的背景噪音可能恰好会打断我们正常的思维模式，让我们的想象力得以漫游，而不会让人无法集中注意力。

ex.s: William Hastie once suggested that history informs us of past mistakes                   we can learn without repeating them.
ex.t: 威廉·哈斯蒂曾经建议历史告诉我们过去的错误                   我们可以从中学习而不必重蹈覆辙。

ex.s: It used to be that you  drive for miles here without seeing another person, but now there are houses and people everywhere.
ex.t: 过去在这里你可以开车数英里看不到一个人但现在到处都是房子和人。

ex.s: digest the meal easilyB. manage without breakfast
ex.t: 这些结果的启示是，要从运动中获得最大的健康益处，不吃东西可能是明智的选择。

ex.s: I never knew anyone who’d grown up in Jackson without being afraid of Mrs Calloway, our librarian.
ex.t: 我从未见过哪个在杰克逊长大的人不怕我们的图书管理员卡洛韦太太。

ex.s: It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 不了解一个历史时期，几乎不可能不对相关概念产生几十个问题。

ex.s: Thanks to the Silence Machine, a British invention, you can get rid of the sound without upsetting the boy or his parents.
ex.t: 多亏了静音机这一英国发明，你可以在不惹恼男孩或他父母的情况下摆脱这种声音。

ex.s: We can't appreciate these kinds of details without seeing works of art as they originally appeared-something Smith believes you can do only when you have a road map.
ex.t: 如果不把这些艺术品按最初的样子来看，我们就无法欣赏此类细节——史密斯认为，只有当你有一张“路线图”时才能做到这一点。

ex.s: Money spent without hesitation.
ex.t: 毫不犹豫地花出的钱。

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 如果赞美是真诚的，并且专注于努力而不是结果，那么你可以像孩子做一些值得口头奖励的事情一样频繁地给予赞美。” 我们应当特别承认我们的孩子努力推动自己并努力实现一个目标，即“无恐惧地养育子女：让忧心忡忡地去关注真正重要的事情”的作者多纳休(Donahue)说。

ex.s: It is not surprising, then, that Macartney left China without negotiating the trade agreement.
ex.t: 因此，马戛尔尼离开中国时未能谈成贸易协定，也就不足为奇了。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短，这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读，而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣。

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱斯解释道：“对许多老年人来说，特别是那些独居或在乡村生活的人来说，驾驶对于保持独立性非常重要，让他们能够自由出行而不必依赖他人。”

ex.s: Similarly, when people go for a few days without sleeping, they get sick.
ex.t: 同样，人如果好几天不睡觉，就会生病。

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

ex.s: It would be impossible to progress in anything, after all, without taking the occasional misstep.
ex.t: 毕竟，不偶尔走错步，任何事都不可能进步。

ex.s: The origin of “hamburger” was a hard beef steak called “Hamburg steak”, eaten without bread.
ex.t: "汉堡"的起源是一种叫做"汉堡牛排"的硬牛肉饼，吃的时候不加面包。
